candidates.question: How can I tell which jobs need attention before customers complain?
candidates.reason: A late complaint is an expensive, recognisable consequence. The mechanism is specific: watch reliable signals, combine context and route one human-reviewed exception.

candidates.reason: Strong owner anxiety and capacity tension, but jobs language is trade-led and the answer-first mechanism is less precise.

commercial_tension_gate.winning_candidate: How can I tell which jobs need attention before customers complain?
commercial_tension_gate.owner: An owner or operations leader in an established Sydney legal, accounting, advisory, property, recruitment, agency or consulting firm with several client matters moving at once.
commercial_tension_gate.loss: Client trust, margin, deadline control and senior capacity are lost when the client becomes the first person to reveal that work has drifted.
commercial_tension_gate.failing_system: Milestone, dependency, scope and rework signals sit across practice software, project tools, inboxes and notes without one exception path.
commercial_tension_gate.run_lighter_mechanism: Connect the existing sources, define three observable thresholds, assemble one reviewable exception with context and route it to the accountable role.
commercial_tension_gate.human_exception: A person decides whether to move a deadline, change a fee, absorb cost, call the client or apply professional judgement.
commercial_tension_gate.one_second_consequence: A client complaint arrives after several earlier warning signals were missed.
commercial_tension_gate.gate_result: passes on content substance, fails the rolling-four audience-mix gate because the published visual was explicitly field-service led

red_team.alternative_one: How many jobs are waiting for someone to notice?
red_team.alternative_two: Why does every unusual job end up with the owner?
red_team.why_winner_won: The complaint reversal creates the clearest commercial consequence and supports an answer-first article with a precise normal-path and exception-path mechanism. The alternatives are either less precise or too close to recent owner-dependency work.
red_team.belief_risk: No client case study or first-party content conversion proves the angle. It should be treated as a credible operating hypothesis, not a performance winner.
red_team.audience_mix_override: Had the package not already been published, the field-service visual would have failed the hard mix gate and required a professional-service documentary scene such as a matter deadline, client approval pack or fee-scope exception.
